question: In which year did Sultan Iltutmish's daughter, Raziyya, become Sultan?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1236 CE.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Sultan Raziyyat-Ud-Dunya Wa Ud-Din, popularly known as **Razia Sultana, was a ruler of the Delhi Sultanate in the northern part of the Indian subcontinent.**
 
• **She was the first female Muslim ruler** of the subcontinent and the only female Muslim ruler of Delhi.
 
• In **1236 CE**, the daughter of Sultan Iltutmish became the sultan of Delhi.
 
• The writer **Minhaj-i-Siraj** recognized that she was capable. But he could not accept a woman as his ruler.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Razia Sultan was very wise, an excellent administrator, brave and a warrior like her father.**
 
• In spite of the fact that her rule was only for the time of three years, her deeds have been saved in the pages of history.
 
• **Razia Sultan's Tomb in Delhi** is one of those spots, which recollects the memory of this courageous woman.
 
• She dressed like a man and sat in an open durbar.
 
• She was an **effective ruler and had the characteristics of a monarch.**
